verdict.rationale: Dynadot's own pages document a public API with more than 120 actions. It covers domains, account settings, DNS, orders, registration, transfer, renewal, deletion, push, aftermarket bidding and backorders, and reseller accounts, so an AI-native user can drive the core product programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), quoted endpoint-level reference and authentication docs in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
Build your account by registering, transferring, and renewing domains through commands. You can even delete and push domains through our API.
Use our API to engage with our aftermarket - place backorder requests, discover new auction listings, place bids, and more.
Our API functions extend to our reseller program, allowing you to manage domains under your Dynadot reseller account efficiently.
